title: What Will the Next 30 Years of Mid-City Look Like?
description:
What will the next 30 years of Mid-City look like? We want to hear from you! 

The City has released the first draft of the Mid-City Communities Plan Update – the first comprehensive update in more than 25 years. Mid-City includes City Heights, Eastern Area, Kensington-Talmadge and Normal Heights. 

The first draft reflects years of community engagement and includes opportunities for more homes, new parks, improved mobility and other neighborhood improvements. 

Continued community feedback is a critical part of the planning process and will help shape the next draft of the plan, which is anticipated to be released later this year. 

Learn more about the draft plan, review the proposed updates, provide feedback and sign up to receive email updates on future engagement opportunities: insidesandiego.org/san-diegans-are-invited-help-shape-future-mid-city-communities
